name: ARIZAL
note: Wikidata P625 (3 dp); Wikipedia 'Aarizal': village, Khansahib tehsil, Budgam, Sukhnag valley at base of Pir Panjal. OSM has no object. Point sits in the Sukhnag valley south of Beerwah. The withheld ArcGIS point was ~14 km further SW near the Pir Panjal crest (shift over 3 km). Judged the CC0 point the better placement (valley village rather than ridge) but LOW confidence; recommend human check.

name: BADRUN
note: OSM village Badran, Beerwah tehsil, Budgam (postcode 193401); also Wikidata Q24948988 (Budgam, 34.0833,74.5833). Route Srinagar-Badrun 25 km matches Beerwah/Magam corridor and ledger (Badran/Budran ~25 km from Srinagar). Shift ~5 km: the withheld point fell in open country with no OSM/Wikidata settlement; Badran is the only recognised variant in the district, and two independent open sources agree on its position.

name: DEVSUR
note: Devsar town, Kulgam district (Devsar tehsil, ~6 km E of Kulgam; Wikidata Q24907418 33.65,75.02). Route 'Devsur to Srinagar' via Kulgam, 65 km. Gazetteer tag Anantnag is outdated (Kulgam split from Anantnag in 2007): district tag wrong.

note: Permit-area label, not a place; no coordinate. No active route uses it.

name: GADOORA
note: Nominatim (Gadoora/Gadura/Gaduraa/Gadur/Gudoora, bounded and unbounded), Wikidata, GeoNames (Gadura: only Jharkhand/Bihar), Wikipedia: nothing in J&K. Deep-dive ledger describes a Ganderbal-border village ~8 km from SKIMS Soura, but no open coordinate exists.

name: GULABAGH
note: Carried over from round 1.

name: HEFF
note: Nominatim (Heff, Hef, Heff Shirmal, with district words), Wikidata, GeoNames (no places), Wikipedia: nothing. Ledger: Heff ~7 km E of Shopian, but no open coordinate.

name: ILLAHIBAGH
note: Ellahi Bagh suburb, Srinagar; OSM also has 'Bus Stop Ellahi Bagh' and 'Illahi Bagh' park/playground within 400 m, attesting the Illahi/Ellahi variant. Round-1 ambiguous resolved.

name: ISGANDERPORA
note: Iskanderpora village, Beerwah tehsil, Budgam (postcode 193411). Round-1 ambiguous resolved: Isgander/Iskander is the same name; in the recorded district, ~50 m from prior point.

name: KATROSOO
note: OSM village Katarus; OSM also has 'PHC KATRASOO' (node 7140654415) 130 m away, attesting Katrasoo as the local spelling of this settlement. Ledger: Katrusu ~7 km from Kulgam.

name: KELLER
note: Wikipedia 'Keller, Shopian' and Wikidata Q60753204 exist but carry NO coordinate. GeoNames 12682761 'Keller' is a third-order administrative division (tehsil, pop 36,389), not the village, so not used. Nominatim: nothing.

name: LOOLPORA
note: Nominatim, Wikidata, GeoNames (no places Lolpora), Wikipedia: nothing. OSM Lalpora (34.009,74.574) is ~20 km from where the route puts it; not accepted.

name: MOMINABAD TENGPORA
note: Searched Tengpora and Mominabad separately. OSM has two Tengpora: a neighbourhood in Batamaloo, Srinagar (this one, postcode 190009) and a hamlet near Ganderbal (34.228,74.780). Mominabad is a Srinagar locality in the Batamaloo/Tengpora area and the permit label is Srinagar-tagged, so the Srinagar Tengpora is where a city route would terminate. The withheld point (shift ~19 km) coincided with the Ganderbal hamlet and was wrong for this label. Mominabad itself has no open coordinate; the point is the Tengpora locality. No active route uses this name.

name: PASTHOON
note: OSM village relation 'Syed Abad (Pastun)', Tral tehsil, Pulwama; nearby peak 'Pastun Bal'. Pastun = Pasthoon (ledger: Tral-tehsil village). Route Srinagar-Pasthoon 41 km via Awantipora fits. Gazetteer tag Budgam is wrong (Tral is in Pulwama). Point is the relation centroid per Nominatim.

name: RATNIPURA
note: Ratnipora village (way centroid), Pulwama tehsil. Route Srinagar-Ratnipura 26 km road vs ~22 km straight line fits; the other Ratnipora (Shopian, 33.686,74.900) is ~44 km straight from Srinagar, too far for a 26 km route. Gazetteer tag Srinagar is wrong.

name: RATSUN
note: Carried over from round 1.

name: SAFAPORA GBL
note: Safapora village (Manasbal, Ganderbal; Wikidata Q16897756). GBL = Ganderbal. Gazetteer tag Budgam is wrong; corroborated by ledger (Manasbal, Ganderbal).

name: SANGERWANI
note: Wikidata/Wikipedia 'Sanger Wani or Sangerwani', village, Pulwama (Rajpora tehsil); P625 is 2 dp (~1 km precision). OSM hamlet 'Sangarwain' (node 9680999672, 33.794,74.717) lies ~3 km SW, likely the same place but a weaker name match, so the exact-name Wikidata point is used.

name: SHANGLIPORA
note: Nominatim, Wikidata, GeoNames (no places), Wikipedia: nothing. OSM Kangripora/Sanoor Kalipora are different names; not used.

name: TREHGAM KUP
note: Trehgam town, Kupwara (KUP = Kupwara; Wikidata Q96410763). Ledger: ~21 km beyond Kupwara town. Gazetteer tag Srinagar is wrong.

name: VIA SHALIMAR
note: 'Via Shalimar' read as Shalimar, Srinagar: centroid of Shalimar Bagh (Mughal garden way) is the only open anchor; it is a landmark, not a settlement, so the point is a proxy for the area. No active route uses this name.

name: VIJIPOPRA
note: Nominatim (Vijipora, Wijpora, Vijpora, Bijipora...), Wikidata, GeoNames (no places Vijpora), Wikipedia: nothing. Ledger: Vijpora in Sonawari/Sumbal belt, Bandipora, but no open coordinate.

name: WASOORA
note: Wikidata/Wikipedia 'Wasoora, Pulwama' (Shahoora tehsil; 14 km E of Pulwama, 50 km from Srinagar). OSM 'Waskura' in Kupwara (91 km away) is a different place and rejected.

name: ZALOORA
note: Wikipedia 'Zaloora' (Q8065547; ~16 km from Sopore, 10 km from Handwara) and Zaingair exist but have NO coordinate; GeoNames: no places; Nominatim nothing.
